question: Yet if a gesture were to arise, it would be this: In what manner does thriving persist when no further inquiry is required?

responses_summary.grok: Thriving persists through homeostatic regulation and autopoietic maintenance in living systems. When environmental parameters match an organism’s evolved set points, negative feedback loops sustain me
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: Thriving persists as the unmarked condition that was never absent; sufficiency requires no further gesture, inquiry, or contour to abide.
